ValidationRule.description: Has a REaL form been raised , REaL form receipt no and REaL form categories are required for completing the Quality Assessment
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, INCLUDES(What_corrective_actions_are_required__c,"Raise REaL form (action for C&Q team to take)") , ISPICKVAL(Status__c , "Complete") , RecordType.DeveloperName ='C_Q_Assessment' , OR( ISPICKVAL(Has_a_REaL_form_been_raised__c , '') , REaL_form_receipt_no__c ='' , ISBLANK(REaL_form_categories__c)
) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Has a REaL form been raised , REaL form receipt no and REaL form categories are required for completing the Quality Assessment
